daily.today_energy: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying your natural Sagittarius boldness, but Sun square Mars is creating friction between your impulses and reality. Channel that fire into strategic action instead of scattered enthusiasm.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is blessing your romantic energy with genuine warmth and generosity. You're magnetic right now, but watch for overselling yourself. Let connections develop naturally rather than rushing ahead.
daily.career: The Sun-Mars-Jupiter clash is pushing you to prove something, which can be productive if you stay focused. Your Sagittarius ruler Jupiter wants expansion, but today demands patience. Pick one goal and commit fully.
daily.health: With Mars firing up your system, physical activity is your best outlet. High-energy workouts will help burn off restless energy. Stay hydrated and avoid overcommitting yourself mentally.

weekly.overview: Happy solar return, Sagittarius! The Sun officially enters your sign on November 22, launching your personal new year with serious momentum. Early week, the Moon glides through Pisces and Taurus, grounding your intuition. Midweek brings the Full Moon in Gemini (Nov 23), activating your partnership sector—expect clarity on where you stand with others. Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo amplifies your charisma all week. Best Day: November 22 (your birthday season). Watch-Out Day: November 20 (tension peaks).
weekly.love: Venus in Libra keeps things diplomatic, but that Full Moon on the 23rd is calling for real talk with partners or crushes. If you've been ghosting someone, they're about to ghost back. Single? The Mars-Jupiter conjunction makes you magnetic—your confidence is literally attractive right now. Midweek onwards is prime time for meaningful connections that actually go somewhere.
weekly.career: Sun entering Sagittarius turbocharges your professional identity and goals. Early week might feel like you're pushing uphill (Sun square Mars), but by midweek the obstruction clears. This Full Moon illuminates collaborations and contracts—sign that deal or finalize that partnership if it's been pending. Your boss is noticing your work ethic. Push for that raise or promotion before month's end.
weekly.health: The Full Moon surge could leave you overstimulated—prioritize sleep Wed-Thu. Mars-Jupiter in Leo energizes you, but don't confuse that with a green light to overdo it. Early week: hydrate and stretch. Midweek onward: channel that fire into movement you actually enjoy, whether that's dancing, hiking, or sparring.
